command:
set -euo pipefail
REPO=https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git
BR=chatgpt-work/omega-research-organs-main-convergence-20260913
EXPECTED_PR=9cae5b1760bc3cf7cdabfa676968cf06f3568b54
REMOTE_PR=$(git ls-remote "$REPO" "refs/heads/$BR" | awk '{print $1}')
echo EXPECTED_PR=$EXPECTED_PR REMOTE_PR=$REMOTE_PR
test "$REMOTE_PR" = "$EXPECTED_PR" || { echo REFUSE_PR_HEAD_MOVED=1; exit 42; }
D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-pr102-converge.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$D"' EXIT
git clone -q "$REPO" "$D/repo"
cd "$D/repo"
git fetch -q origin "$BR" main
git checkout -q -B "$BR" "origin/$BR"
MAIN1=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
echo MAIN_BEFORE=$MAIN1
if ! git merge --no-edit origin/main; then echo PR102_MAIN_MERGE_CONFLICT=1; git status --short; git merge --abort || true; exit 23; fi
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_research_organs.py tests/test_voice777_installer_convergence.py tests/test_omega_final_assembly.py tests/test_omega_organ_activity.py tests/test_omega_acoustic_authority_convergence.py
python3 scripts/omega_runtime.py selftest
REMOTE_PR2=$(git ls-remote "$REPO" "refs/heads/$BR" | awk '{print $1}')
MAIN2=$(git ls-remote "$REPO" refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')
echo REMOTE_PR_AFTER=$REMOTE_PR2 MAIN_AFTER=$MAIN2
test "$REMOTE_PR2" = "$EXPECTED_PR" || { echo REFUSE_PR_HEAD_CHANGED_DURING_TEST=1; exit 43; }
test "$MAIN2" = "$MAIN1" || { echo REFUSE_MAIN_CHANGED_DURING_TEST=1; exit 44; }
git push -q origin HEAD:"refs/heads/$BR"
echo PR102_CONVERGED_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo OMEGA_PR102_CURRENT_MAIN_CONVERGENCE_PASS=1
